item.title: Metaplanet cuts Series 10 stock pool by 41%, plans Hong Kong subsidiary
item.description: Metaplanet will cut 131.3 million potential shares and form a $1 million Hong Kong subsidiary for trading in Bitcoin, equities and credit products.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Zoltan Vardai

item.title: Trading stocks against BONER is the latest trend for DeFi degens
item.description: Why would anyone want to trade a healthcare stock for a memecoin like BONER? Why wouldn’t they, ask the degens on Robinhood Chain who are building a strange new corner of DeFi.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Christina Comben

item.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
item.description: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Yohan Yun

item.title: Bitcoin ETF outflows accelerate as investors pull $449M in three days
item.description: ARK 21Shares accounted for $164 million of Thursday’s Bitcoin ETF withdrawals, while Ether and Solana funds also recorded net outflows.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Zoltan Vardai

item.title: Robinhood’s crypto volume increases 61% in August, still down 38% YoY
item.description: Bitstamp accounted for $10.1 billion of Robinhood’s August crypto volume, while trading on the Robinhood app fell 46% from a year earlier.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Yohan Yun

item.title: UniCredit seeks infrastructure partner for crypto trading, custody: Report
item.description: The Italian bank is reportedly seeking assistance in launching access to crypto trading, custody and tokenized investment products.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Zoltan Vardai

item.title: Bitcoin buyers wary of July sub-$58K floor amid onchain data ‘anomaly’
item.description: Bitcoin HODL waves data revealed an unusually muted reaction to Bitcoin’s drop below $58,000, raising questions over its status as a bear-market floor.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by William Suberg

item.title: Standard Chartered forecasts SKY rising fivefold to $0.325 by 2028
item.description: The bank expects Sky to pass five times as much value to token holders by 2028 as USDS adoption and borrowing capacity continue to expand.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Zoltan Vardai

item.title: India launches tokenized bond pilot with $107M issued
item.description: SEBI said later phases of Demat 2.0 will introduce secondary trading and open the tokenized bonds to retail investors.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Ezra Reguerra

item.title: Anthropic says Claude used for cyberattacks and surveillance
item.description: A Russian-speaking operator targeted more than 20 organizations, while a Mali consultant used Claude to build a mass-surveillance platform.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Zoltan Vardai

item.title: Blockstream rejects ransom as Liquid hackers hold nearly 600 BTC
item.description: Blockstream said it would work with law enforcement, exchanges and forensic specialists to recover the Bitcoin if the hackers do not return it.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Ezra Reguerra

item.title: Bitwise to put down Dogecoin ETF less than a year after launch
item.description: BWOW held about $688,000 in net assets as of Sept. 9. Trading is expected to end Oct. 14, with cash payouts to follow around Oct. 22.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Yohan Yun

item.title: SBF asks Supreme Court to overturn conviction, $11B forfeiture: Report
item.description: Bankman-Fried’s lawyers challenged the exclusion of evidence about customer losses and argued that his $11 billion forfeiture was excessive.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Zoltan Vardai

item.title: Revised CLARITY Act targets ‘non-decentralized’ DeFi operators
item.description: The bill’s ethics section remained largely unchanged despite being one of the main points of contention ahead of a pivotal Senate vote.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Ezra Reguerra

item.title: Brevo login flaw enabled phishing email targeting 347K Trezor subscribers
item.description: Trezor told Cointelegraph that the phishing email was sent to 347,000 subscribers and said it is treating every address as “known to the attacker and possibly reusable for phishing.”
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Ezra Reguerra

item.title: Metaplanet equity backlash, SE Asia crypto funding doubles: Asia Express
item.description: Shareholders of Bitcoin treasury company Metaplanet are seething over equity allocations for insiders, while new figures cement Singapore’s role as the top Asian crypto hub.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Andrew Fenton

item.title: ESMA warns growing crypto ties could amplify risks to traditional finance
item.description: The EU securities regulator flagged tokenized equities, DeFi exploits and prediction markets as areas where growing crypto ties could pose risks to the broader financial system.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Nate Kostar

item.title: UK House of Lords backs mandatory digital asset strategy over Labour position
item.description: The amendment would require the UK Treasury to develop a strategy covering cryptoassets, stablecoins, tokenized securities and digital financial infrastructure.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Nate Kostar

item.title: Liquid Network resumes block production after $320M exploit
item.description: Liquid restarted block production after deploying emergency software updates, though transactions and peg operations remain suspended as recovery efforts continue.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Nate Kostar

item.title: MoneyGram launches Visa stablecoin card as remittance rivals expand
item.description: MoneyGram is following rival Western Union’s lead, rolling out a Visa stablecoin debit card as it expands blockchain-based payments.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Robert Lakin

item.title: EU finance groups push to remove tokenized securities cap
item.description: European finance and tokenization groups say Brussels should remove limits on assets admitted to DLT infrastructure or set a 1.5 trillion euro baseline if a cap remains.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Nate Kostar

item.title: Bitcoin falls on US PPI overshoot as 30-year bond yield hits new 19-year high
item.description: Bitcoin fell with US stocks as high inflation and a further surge in oil prices coincided with another multidecade high for US bond yields.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by William Suberg

item.title: Coinbase, Moov to provide stablecoin infrastructure for US community banks
item.description: The partnership will provide stablecoin acceptance, settlement and real-time funding capabilities to over 1,000 community banks and credit unions.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Zoltan Vardai

item.title: Solana sees record 263K tokens issued in a single day
item.description: Memecoin platform Pump.fun accounted for most of the new tokens among launchpads, as the Solana network notched a new all-time daily issuance high.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Zoltan Vardai

item.title: Ex-BoE deputy governor headlines trio of former central bankers joining Fnality
item.description: Jon Cunliffe, Jochen Metzger and Ron Berndsen join Fnality Europe’s supervisory board as the company works to expand beyond its sterling payment system.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Yohan Yun

item.title: Nasdaq invests $100M in Kraken parent at $21B valuation: Report
item.description: Nasdaq invested $100 million in Payward as part of its push toward tokenized stock products with round-the-clock trading.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Zoltan Vardai

item.title: Treasury Secretary Bessent urges CLARITY Act passage after Senate returns
item.description: Secretary Scott Bessent warned that failing to pass the CLARITY Act would send a “troubling signal” about America’s leadership in the digital asset industry.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Zoltan Vardai

item.title: Hunter Biden denies profiting from memecoin after his LAPTOP crashes
item.description: Nansen found a $117,800 unrealized loss in one wallet as the team announced liquidity incentives and Bubblemaps flagged fresh top holders.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Yohan Yun

item.title: Bitcoin ETFs shed $167M after strongest three-week inflow run of 2026
item.description: ARKB led Wednesday’s Bitcoin ETF outflows as Ether and Solana funds returned to net inflows.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Ezra Reguerra

item.title: Bitcoin sell-side risk returns to rare lows as $80K sellers fade from view
item.description: Bitcoin investors showed little sign of panic selling as BTC held most of its August gains and sell-side risk fell to rare lows, data showed.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by William Suberg
